name: TrueWood Black Oak Slats, Black Felt
summary: Solid rubberwood slats with a matte black oak veneer on the front, sides, and edges, backed by black acoustic felt.

texture.note: No manufacturer slat specification is published: eight slats per panel are counted from the gallery, giving a 1.475 in pitch from the recorded 11.8 in panel width; 1.0 in faces, 0.475 in rectangular felt-backed gaps, small rounded edges and 0.51 in relief above felt are photo estimates, while 0.75 in total thickness is from the panel record. The tile covers eight pitches by 23.6 in with wrapping vertical grain; matte charcoal-black oak face tones and subtle variation are sampled from main.jpg, with black felt estimated from its backing and no colors taken from the natural-wood gallery examples.
